findings.finding: Q3 deals add roughly SEK 44m of contracted rent to the portfolio: Gothenburg SEK 514m triple-net at SEK 39m rent (~7.6% initial yield) and Malmö SEK 73m at SEK 5.3m, against a ~3.5% average funding cost. The 1 Oct earnings ability should therefore step up about 3-5% per share from SEK 2.66, but every input was press-released.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SLP's observed report-day moves (close-to-close from Yahoo, issuer dates from the Nasdaq feed): 2024-10-17 +2.4, 2025-02-06 -1.2, 2025-04-16 +0.1, 2025-07-10 -0.3, 2025-10-16 -0.2, 2026-02-05 -3.0, 2026-04-16 +3.3, 2026-07-09 +2.0. Earnings-ability step-ups have been routine and moved the stock about 2% at most.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The deals were press-released (stock +0.7% on the day) and analysts can roll the earnings-ability table forward. The only unpriced part is the exact per-share step, including leases that commence and funding cost. If the market had ignored the deals, the stock would not have tracked the sector index so closely through September.

findings.finding: Q3 was a rate shock to Swedish property: the 5-year swap rose from ~2.5% to ~3.2% (Atrium Ljungberg Q3). Yet the first Swedish property Q3 report kept its average yield requirement unchanged (+0.2% value change in Q3). That points to SLP's Newsec yield (5.9%, unchanged for 7 quarters) also holding, NAV rising to about SEK 36 against a 32.2 spot, and an unrealised gain on SLP's SEK 6.2bn of swaps.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: SLP has never reported a yield-requirement change in the 10 quarters shown in the Q2 report (5.9% throughout from Q3 2024), so there is no reaction history for a NAV surprise on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: The sector sold off on the rate rise (SLP -12.3% over 60 days against Catena -14.7%, NP3 -15.1%, Balder -10.5%, OMXS30 +3.2%; Yahoo closes). That price assumes NAV pressure. If valuers hold yields, the discount to NAV widens further, which the price does not yet show. This is macro-to-company transmission through an office peer with internal valuations, so it remains a hypothesis.
findings.independence: Sector price action on the Riksbank's hawkish hold of 24 Sep (SLP -4.7%, peers -2.4% to -3.8% that day) shows the rate channel, not the valuation outcome: https://www.riksbank.se/sv/penningpolitik/penningpolitisk-rapport/2026/penningpolitiskt-beslut-september-2026/
